Package info.openrocket.core.simulation

Class SimulationOptions

java.lang.Object
info.openrocket.core.simulation.SimulationOptions
All Implemented Interfaces:
info.openrocket.core.simulation.SimulationOptionsInterface, info.openrocket.core.util.ChangeSource, Cloneable
public class SimulationOptions extends Object implements info.openrocket.core.util.ChangeSource, Cloneable, info.openrocket.core.simulation.SimulationOptionsInterface
A class holding simulation options in basic parameter form and which functions as a ChangeSource. A SimulationConditions instance is generated from this class using toSimulationConditions().
